Hi Claire — thanks for the note. Happy to help. I've attached a draft one-pager with the definitions we recommend and a short checklist AEs can run through before moving an opportunity to Commit.

Topline definitions (summary):
- Pipeline: Active opportunities that meet basic qualification criteria but have no documented close plan or no committed economic buyer engagement.
- Best Case: Opportunities where there's a positive buying signal (proposal sent, favorable timeline) but outstanding dependencies remain (PO timing, legal, budget committee).
- Commit: Opportunities with clear, documented commitment from the buyer (signed MOU/PO, explicit verbal confirmation from named approver with timeline) and alignment on deployment/term exceptions.

Decision rules (attached doc has examples and a short rubric):
- Move to Commit only when 2/3 checklist items are met (contract owner confirmed, budget approved, go/no-go date agreed).
- Best Case should capture optimistic but plausible outcomes (probability ~50-70%) and be annotated with open risks.

We can run a 30-min workshop Tue Jun 29 at 10:00am PT (I'll record). Does that work for you? If so, I'll invite your ops managers and a few AEs and circulate the slides in advance.

Cheers,
